$schema.description: The schema used for this file

type.description: The type of this configuration file

name.description: The name of the filament sensor

description.description: A description of the filament sensor

manufacturer.description: The name of the manufacturer of this filament sensor

hasButton.description: Whether this filament sensor has a button

sensePinAlias.description: The pin alias for the filament sensor sense pin. Default is 'filament_sensor_sense_pin'.

buttonPinAlias.description: The pin alias for the filament sensor button pin. Default is 'filament_sensor_button_pin'.

additionalRequiredPins.description: Additional pin aliases required by this filament sensor. Note that filament_sensor_sense_pin is always required, and filament_sensor_button_pin is required if hasButton is true.

template.description: TypeScript template for this filament sensor (path relative to /src/templates/filament-sensors/)

templateProperties.description: Custom properties for this filament sensor. These properties can be consumed by the template, enabling template reuse for similar filament sensors.
